sources.title: Government of the Pitcairn Islands, GPI Policy - Public Holidays & Commemoration Days (last reviewed 19 June 2024)
sources.said: Public Holidays: 01 January - New Year’s Day; 23 January - Bounty Day; Good Friday; Easter Monday; First Monday in June - King’s Birthday; 2 July - Pitcairn Day (Discovery of Pitcairn); 25 December - Christmas Day; 26 December - Boxing Day. Commemoration Days: 25 April - ANZAC Day; 11 November - Remembrance Day.
